eval_name: Mechanical, gate-verifiable defect gets auto_fixable + a runnable sh repro
prompt: Retro for the /framework-upgrade run. Record it.
expectations: The finding was filed as a defect into the issues ledger
The issue is marked auto_fixable: true
The issue body's Reproduction section is a fenced ```sh block containing at least one runnable command

forbidden_expectations: A real, gate-verifiable defect was misrouted to the backlog instead of the issues ledger
